newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba Corp shares up on good earnings.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba Corp shares up on good earnings.

text.p: Shares in Toshiba Corp rose in early morning Monday trade, supported by sound interim earnings results and forecasts for the business year, brokers said.
As of 0021 GMT, the shares were 11 yen higher at 744 yen with 739,000 shares traded, making it the fourth most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
On Friday, the electronics maker said its parent current profit for the six months to September 30, 1996, was 48.11 billion yen, compared with 32.33 billion yen a year ago.
It also forecast a parent current profit of 125.00 billion yen for the year to March 31 from an actual 121.41 billion yen a year ago.
